Variant 1

Stats

Dwarf_Hill_Cultist_Bane_BlackGauntlet
Black Gauntlets are cultists of Bane and the senior-most officers under Lord Enver Gortash.
“
Hahns Rives! Calls himself a Banite when he's a disgrace to the Tyranny Lord! A Black Gauntlet - Rives? What a joke! I should be the Black Gauntlet of the Foundry Lab Level.
 „
— Rives' Failures as a Banite


Involvement

Act Three

Black Gauntlets command Banite cultists in key locations in Baldur's Gate such as Wyrm's Rock Fortress and the Steel Watch Foundry.

One unnamed female Black Gauntlet of Bane is in the Upper City Sewers.

Combat

Black Gauntlets are potent spellcasters and have spell slots equivalent to a level 12 caster. Their exact spell list varies between different Black Gauntlets but they generally have ⁠Necrotic damage spells and mind-controlling spells drawn from the Cleric or Wizard spell list.
